issue_context.title: In gRPC message, indicate the Analyze is Auto Analyze or not
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

As a pre-request of auto analyze flow control,  TiDB server needs to tell backend TiKV if the Analyze request is from Auto Analyze or user's manual ones.

review_comments: Any test to cover this case?
No test case for it yet. I tested it manually at TiKV server side.
